easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Cast Mana Crypt by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Crypt enters, Grinding Station and Surge Conductor trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Mana Crypt, causing a player to mill three cards.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Crypt from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
